name: L7824
description: Positive 24V fixed linear regulator from the 78xx family, up to 1.5A with a heatsink, in TO-220. TO-220 pin order is IN(1)/GND(2)/OUT(3) with the metal tab electrically GND.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: unregulated input voltage (leftmost lead, face toward you)

pins.name: GND
pins.description: ground / common (center, also the metal tab)

TO-220.notes: printed face toward you, leads down: IN, GND, OUT left to right. The metal tab is electrically GROUND (pin 2). ST draws the datasheet figure tab-left/leads-right (top view); rotate to the leads-down pose to get this order.

typical_application: Fixed +24V on-card supply (industrial / sensor / motor-logic rails) from an unregulated ~28-35V source, with a heatsink for currents near 1.5A.
gotchas: positive 78xx TO-220 is IN/GND/OUT with tab=GND; this is OPPOSITE the negative 79xx TO-220 (GND/IN/OUT) whose tab is NOT ground
the tab is GND, so it can mount directly to a grounded heatsink without an insulator (unlike a 79xx)
ST's datasheet figure is drawn tab-left/leads-right; reading it literally without rotating can fool you into thinking pin 1 is OUTPUT
needs ~2V headroom (dropout); input must stay above ~26V to hold 24V out
